SecurityBaseline._comment: Interactive: BitLocker USB enforcement (Y/N, default: N); Defender sample submission (Y/N, default: N = safe samples only, the documented privacy deviation from Microsoft's SubmitSamplesConsent=3; Y restores 3 = send all samples); SmartScreen level (Y/N, default: N = Warn, the NoID Privacy default: SmartScreen stays active and warns, a trusted download can still be started with Run anyway; Y = Block, Microsoft's baseline value without that bypass); UAC Strict=0 automatically denies standard-user elevation; SecureDesktop=1 permits standard users to enter separate administrator credentials on the secure desktop. This system-wide standard-user choice does not change an administrator account's own elevation prompts. adminProtectionMode: Consent = Administrator protection with a Yes/No prompt on the secure desktop (NoID Privacy default); Credentials = Microsoft's Administrator protection asks for PIN, password or Windows Hello when an app requests administrator rights (baseline); Classic = no Administrator protection, classic Yes/No elevation prompt (for Hyper-V or compatibility problems with elevated WSL and developer tools). A change takes effect after a restart.

ASR._comment: Interactive: Management tools (Y/N), Prevalence rule (Y/N), Cloud protection off: a notice, all rules are applied. Unattended: continueWithoutCloud=true applies all rules (NoID Privacy default), false applies no ASR rule

Privacy._comment: Interactive: Mode (1-3: 1 = Strict, the NoID Privacy default; 2 = MSRecommended; 3 = Paranoid), Cloud Clipboard (Y/N, MSRecommended only), Tier 1 policy-based in-box app removal (Y/N, default N; unmanaged single-session Enterprise/Education 24H2+ only; device-wide app-data loss warning; exact policy-value restore but no exact downstream app/data recovery), Tier 2 classic per-user app removal (Y/N, default N; app data can be lost; separate original-user-only best-effort recovery, Windows' local copy first, then the Microsoft Store, NOT exact), then optional Weather/Widgets board removal (Y/N, default N; valid only with Tier 2).

AntiAI.description: Hardening of 50 declared Windows/Edge AI registry targets plus four Copilot URI source checks; Recall policies delete existing snapshots, which registry restore cannot recover; blocking the Copilot app from launching requires AppLocker/App Control

EdgeHardening.description: Microsoft Edge v151: 24 baseline values plus 9 explicit privacy additions (32 default-selected; 33 with extension block-all)
EdgeHardening._comment: Interactive: Allow extensions (Y/N, default: Y); allow dynamic code in the Edge browser process so Edge can print (Y/N, default: Y; N writes the Microsoft baseline value DynamicCodeSettings=1)

AdvancedSecurity.description: Advanced Security hardening beyond MS Baseline
AdvancedSecurity._comment: Interactive: Profile (1-3), Windows Firewall layer (Y/N; controller detection is prefill only), RDP (Y/N on host-capable editions), Admin shares (Y/N, domain only), UPnP (Y/N), Wireless Display (Y/N on supported editions), Discovery Protocols (Maximum only, Y/N), IPv6 0xFF component disable (Maximum only, Y/N). Home reports RDP-host, WirelessDisplay and optional-content Windows Update policy targets as NotApplicable; the Delivery Optimization policy applies on every edition.

options._comment: nonInteractive=true replaces every decision prompt with the exact validated module values above. DryRun and verbose logging are explicit CLI switches; automatic reboot/confirmation is not supported.
